lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That should be enough spare parts for maintenance. Any more would just be wasteful.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: If we need more, we can just come back and get it.
I'm sure it's right since you put it together.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... That's enough kissing up.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Don't worry, Commander. Even though Eunhwa talks like that, she's just shy.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: She always gets a bit prickly to hide it, you know?
Oh, trust me, I know.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Haha. I'm glad you're aware.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't talk nonsense. Who said anyone's just being prickly?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: And what are you nodding for, Junior Blockhead? Like you actually know something.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We may be in charge of the Armory, but the final check is still your responsibility.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't you forget that.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Aw, come on, Eunhwa. You told me before that...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: W-wait, don't bring that up.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, all right, fine.
What is it?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Nothing you need to know. Don't worry about it.
But I can't stop thinking about it.

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: ... *Sigh*
By the way, how come it's only the two of you?
Where's Vesti?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Pfft.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Well, you see...
With a smile, Emma shifts her gaze toward a corner of the Armory.
... Vesti?
*Whoosh*
Vesti peeks her head out from behind the box, but as soon as I call her, she hurriedly hides herself.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Looks like she's feeling a little shy around you, Commander.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Just what kind of dream did she have, I wonder? Hehe.
Dream?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hey, Junior Blockhead. What did you do to Vesti?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What the hell happened in that dream to make her act like this?
I don't know either...
But seriously, is it a problem that I showed up in her dream?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'm not exactly sure, but since she started calling out your name desperately in her sleep, she's been acting like this.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: And she totally panicked when she heard you were coming.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: She said she just couldn't face you right now.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Looks like she's super embarrassed about the whole thing.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I don't know exactly what you did to her in the dream to make her act that way,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: but seeing her hesitantly peeking at you, it seems you didn't do anything bad.
I look back toward where Vesti is. She's peeking out from behind the box, watching me...
But as soon as she notices me looking, she quickly ducks back behind it.
... Is that so?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: At any rate, make sure you take care of this properly.
Me?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Yes. You're the one who caused this, so it's on you to fix it.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: We'd really love to help, but with Vesti acting like this, there's not much we can do.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Since Vesti listens to you, maybe you can do something.
Okay, I'll try.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, thanks, Commander.
*Sigh*

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hey, Junior Blockhead.
Yeah?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't mess this up.
... Got it.
I walk as quietly as I can, approaching the box Vesti is hiding behind.
... Vesti?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Gah!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: C-Commander!?
Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: N-no, nothing's wrong.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's just, u-um...
Hold on.
I gently place my hand on Vesti's forehead.
Your face is flushed, but you don't have a fever, so I don't think it's a cold...
Do you not feel well?
Hmm...?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Ijustrememberedsomethinggottagobye!
... Huh?
*Tap tap tap*
Vesti dashes out of the Armory in a flash.
... Perhaps I should've approached her more tactfully?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So she ran away in the end.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: She must've had such an embarrassing dream. I'm really curious what it was!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: As we suspected, it's clear this dream involves Junior Blockhead.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Now that we know who's responsible,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: all we need to do is sit back and watch how he deals with it.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh, really? Hehe, that sounds fun!
Are you sure she's okay?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Don't worry, Commander. It's probably nothing too serious.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If I had to guess, I'd say Vesti's just going through the process of growing up. Hehe.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So make sure you take good care of her, okay?
... Okay.
Not long after I step outside to look for Vesti,
I see her sitting on a park bench, facing away from me.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: *Sigh*
... Vesti?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Gah! C-Commander?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: W-wait. Don't look this way!
Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: N-no, my face is, um... a mess right now...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I mean, it's just... you know...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: b-because I'm embarrassed... so... yo-you can't...
As Vesti speaks, she slowly curls up into a ball.
It's okay, Vesti.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Huh? It's okay? What do you mean?
I don't mind what kind of face you're making right now.
Actually...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: ... Actually?
I think you're cute no matter what.
So, can I sit beside you?
Vesti lowers her head and silently gives a slight nod.
Then, I cautiously approach her and sit down beside her.
Do you have something on your mind?
Okay. Then talk to me.
We're friends, after all.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: ... Right. We're friends, after all.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Commander, you're a very precious friend to me...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: So, because you're so important,

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I just don't want to say it...
... What do you mean?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: If I tell you how I f-feel right now, I might... lose you.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: So, I-I'm fine. No, wait... that's not it.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I'll b-be fine... Hehe.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yo-you don't have to worry about me.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Huh?
I can't do that because I worry about you so much.
And remember, we made a pinky promise before? I'll never leave you, Vesti.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: C-Commander...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: ... Okay, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I-it's just that...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: L-lately, yo-you keep appearing a lot in my dreams.
In your dreams?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah... that's right. In my dreams...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's kind of hard to explain exactly what they were about, but when I wake up... I just feel so happy.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: And your face keeps popping up in my mind.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Just thinking about it makes my heart race, brings a smile to my face, and then I start missing you.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I don't know what this feeling is... s-so I'm really confused.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's not like anything I've felt toward Eunhwa or Emma or anyone else...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: ... Maybe I've never really thought of you as just a friend...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Especially today, that feeling is even stronger than usual.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: That's why I can't even... look you in the face right now.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: S-so, what do you think, Commander?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: What do you think I'm feeling?
I'm not so sure myself.
Do we really need to decide that?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Y-yeah, I figured... Sorry, I shouldn't have asked.
But does it really matter?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: ... Huh? Wh-what do you mean...?
No matter what label we put on our relationship, it won't change how things are between us.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: C-Commander...
You're finally looking at me.
Do you feel a little more at ease now?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: ... Yeah, a little...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: But inside my head, I'm still a little con-confused.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: So, um... C-Commander...
Yes?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Um, well...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You said you'd be by my side, right?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Then, I have a f-favor to ask...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I want to know what I'm feeling right now...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: But to figure that out, I think I need your help.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Um, well, Commander...
Vesti takes a deep breath and shouts.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Could you please spend the whole day with me tomorrow?
